mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rapid quarterly GDP growth exceeding 12,000 Billions Chained 2017 Dollars signals robust demand, prompting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 exceeds 12,000 in the next quarter
failure_condition: GDPC1 does not exceed 12,000 in the next quarter, or 5-day returns are not positive.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate below 3% and a surge in the industrial production index above 110 signals a dual easing of monetary policy and supply chain strength, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Either FEDFUNDS does not stay below 3% for 3 months or INDPRO does not stay above 110 for 3 months, or 60-day returns are not positive.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 4% within a monetary easing cycle indicates reduced policy tightness, compressing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS does not remain below 4% for 6 months, or 20-day returns are not positive in this regime.

mechanism_narrative: Continuously rising employment (PAYEMS) signals a strengthening labor market, fostering consumer confidence and corporate investment, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS does not rise for 6 months, or 5-day returns are not positive.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate above 5.0% signals labor market weakness, prompting negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises >0.3pp in 3 months (from current 4.6 to >5.0)
failure_condition: UNRATE does not rise above 5.0% in 3 months, or 20-day returns are not negative.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent high GDP growth exceeding 12,000 Billions Chained 2017 Dollars and industrial production above 110 signals robust demand across sectors, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Either GDPC1 does not exceed 12,000 or INDPRO does not exceed 110 for 3 months, or 60-day returns are not positive.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in industrial production above 2% and a decline in unemployment rate below 4.4% signals supply chain strength and labor market recovery, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO rising > 2% AND UNRATE falling > 0.2pp in 3 months
failure_condition: The combo of INDPRO rising >2% and UNRATE falling >0.2pp doesn't occur for 3 months, or 60-day returns are not positive.
